lead.title: Palo Alto Networks to buy AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5B in stock
lead.summary: The cybersecurity giant agreed to acquire Applied Compute, a 2025 startup founded by former OpenAI researchers that helps enterprises post-train, deploy and run open-weight models. The all-stock deal, announced alongside Q1 earnings, values the company at $4.5B just weeks after a $3.25B round, and Palo Alto shares rose about 8.5% after hours.

top_stories.title: Nous Research brings Hermes Agent into Microsoft Teams and Azure
top_stories.summary: A partnership with Microsoft puts Hermes Agent inside Microsoft Teams, the Microsoft Store and Azure, with agent workloads running in isolated Azure Container Apps sandboxes. Enterprises can run Hermes in their own Azure tenant for data-residency reasons.

top_stories.title: Google ships Genie 4 to the Gemini API and AI Studio
top_stories.summary: One day after launch, Genie 4 is available to developers through the Gemini API and AI Studio, generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized audio from text or a reference image. It is the first model on the new Live Interactions API, with real-time navigation and SynthID watermarking.

top_stories.title: How OpenAI's Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
top_stories.summary: OpenAI detailed an internal Codex-powered system that automatically investigates and fixes performance regressions in ChatGPT. Its first Regression Workflow has tracked more than 1,700 investigations and root-caused over 600 cases in just over three months.

top_stories.title: Google partners with Blue Origin on Project Suncatcher heavy-lift launch
top_stories.summary: Google signed Blue Origin for the first heavy-lift launch of its space-compute moonshot, targeted for Q1 2027 on a New Glenn rocket. The satellites, each roughly the capacity of a data center rack, would go to sun-synchronous orbit to tap orbital solar power for AI infrastructure.

items.title: FastFrames: Apple pushes video generation to interactive latency
items.summary: Apple's autoregressive video diffusion family replaces VAE decoding and KV-cache updates, which account for over half of inference time. The 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame on a single B200 while matching a model nearly 8x slower.

items.title: Benchleaking is accelerating: base models regurgitate hidden test items
items.summary: Few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks shows ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base leaking 96% of HumanEval problems with reference implementations, versus 9% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base. A proposed Anti-Hack score costs the worst offender 16.6 points on average.

items.title: Sage S2.1 Flash: a 320B MoE with encoders for molecules, genes and spectra
items.summary: The general-purpose MoE with dedicated molecular, biological and spectral encoders ranks first among five baselines on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB and SpreadsheetBench 2.

items.title: Weight-space programming doesn't need Transformers
items.summary: Three frontier LLMs asked to design their own architecture for few-shot tasks all converge on sparse tables queried by a fixed procedure, beating the most accurate Transformer they wrote with about 1,800x fewer parameters.

items.title: Multi-Branch Transformer cuts KV-cache storage and speeds decoding
items.summary: Branching a Transformer into parallel block sequences fused before shared final layers beats sequential Transformers at matched compute in 0.8B-2.1B pretraining, cutting KV-cache storage up to 34% and raising throughput up to 51.4% on one H200.

items.title: Tencent releases Hy4 flash open weights: 224B MoE, 12B active, 1M context
items.summary: Two days after the apps-and-API launch, Tencent shipped three checkpoints — standard, FP8 and pretrained base — on Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode under the Tencent Hy License. Community ExLlamaV3 and GGUF quantizations were online within 48 hours.

items.title: RadixArk's DaisyRose-27B: Qwen3.8-27B post-trained with RL only, Apache 2.0
items.summary: The first RadixArk model was trained purely with reinforcement learning on about 1,200 long-horizon agent tasks — no SFT, no distillation — at a cost of roughly 63,000 GPU-hours. Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 rises from 5.6% to 12.0%, with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 weights.

items.title: Community squeezes Hy4 flash to ExLlamaV3 within 48 hours of weight release
items.summary: A community EXL3 quantization appeared the day after Tencent published the weights, alongside five official GGUF builds and reports of fitting the resident part of the 220B MoE into roughly 49GB of memory.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon as Microsoft drops three new models
items.summary: Beyond AI News rounds up the release wave: Gemini 4 Neon, three new Microsoft models, a new recursive self-improvement effort and Kling video generation reaching 8K resolution.

items.title: Anthropic makes historic Nasdaq debut
items.summary: Bloomberg Technology covers Anthropic beginning trading on Nasdaq, the first public listing of a leading frontier model developer.

items.title: GPT 6.2 Astra arrives alongside Anthropic's public listing
items.summary: AI Explained argues a larger story sits behind both headlines as OpenAI ships a point release of its flagship model the same week Anthropic went public.

items.title: Suno launches Visuals for AI music videos and album art
items.summary: Images and clips of up to 15 seconds per song — including lip-synced lyric videos — arrive on web, iOS and Android, running on the H3 Move model derived from MiniMax's H3.

items.title: Superhuman pushes its Go assistant across Mail and Docs
items.summary: The Go agent becomes Superhuman's central assistant with proactive behavior, cross-app context, native agents in Docs and 20 new connected third-party agents via its Go SDK.

items.title: Canva adds a master switch to turn off most generative AI
items.summary: Two free settings for Free and Pro users hide generative AI features across the app and reduce AI-generated content in search and recommendations, with no plan upgrade required.

items.title: Docker relaunches with a stack for governing AI agents
items.summary: The new positioning centers on agent trust, with Docker Hardened Images, standalone local and cloud Docker Sandboxes, and Docker AI Governance for enterprise-wide policy.

items.title: Onlook is an open-source design tool for visual engineers
items.summary: The Apache-2.0, YC W25 project lets designers build and style real React and Tailwind code directly, working alongside agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It has about 27k GitHub stars.

items.title: Italian AI startups ride the new innovation wave as the national AI market hits €1.8B
items.summary: Italy's AI market grew 50% year on year in 2025, and the Politecnico di Milano AI Observatory counts 1,010 Italian companies offering AI products, including 135 funded startups.

items.title: Planckian wins €10M from the EIC as one of three Italian deep-tech spin-offs selected
items.summary: The Pisa-based quantum processor spin-off of the University of Pisa and Scuola Normale Superiore gets €2.5M in grants plus €7.5M in equity, one of only three Italian companies on the 35-company EIC Accelerator list.

items.title: Italy is now the world's third-largest exporter of hi-tech machinery
items.summary: The Ingenium 2026 report puts Italy third worldwide with €30B in 2025 automation and technology machinery exports and fourth in industrial robots, flagging 2026-2028 as a strategic window into humanoid robotics supply chains.

items.title: Boltz raises $110M Series A led by Bessemer for AI molecular design
items.summary: The London-based MIT spinout building open-source and commercial models for protein and small-molecule design takes total funding to ~$138M, with Nvidia joining and pharma partners including Pfizer, GSK and Takeda.

items.title: Linq raises $90M led by a16z at $1B valuation for AI agent infrastructure
items.summary: The Series B funds messaging, voice and computer-use infrastructure that lets AI agents text, call and operate software; Ben Horowitz joins the board and total funding exceeds $120M.

items.title: Payhawk raises $280M Series C at $2B valuation led by Goldman Sachs
items.summary: The AI-native spend management platform, repositioning as a finance OS built around AI agents, takes total funding past $515M and operates in 33 countries.

items.title: MegaRobo raises nearly $200M with Oman sovereign fund for AI-for-Science
items.summary: The Suzhou-based lab-automation robotics company counts ~$600M in total funding, with the Oman Investment Authority joining CMB International and returning backers.

items.title: Everful raises $48.5M Series A for AI-driven factory sourcing
items.summary: Founded by ex-Alibaba execs, Everful uses agents on a supply-and-demand world model to source from 30,000+ vetted Chinese factories, shipping 5M+ items a month to 60+ countries.
